services.name: TV and wall mounting
services.blurb: TVs, floating shelves and mirrors mounted level into studs, with cables tucked out of sight.

services.name: Furniture assembly
services.blurb: Flat-pack dressers, desks, bed frames and wardrobes built, anchored to the wall and boxes hauled away.

services.name: Drywall repair

services.name: Faucets and toilets

services.name: Tub and shower caulking

services.name: Rental turnover repairs

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: I picked six items in the punch-list tool and it said three to five hours. The tech finished in four and a quarter, and the bill matched the band Nadia sent me the night before.
reviews.name: Megan T.

reviews.text: Two dressers, a bed frame and a desk for my daughter's apartment near campus, all built in one afternoon and strapped to the wall. They even took the cardboard away.
reviews.name: Rafael G.

reviews.text: I texted the photos from their checklist: a wide shot, a close-up, a tape measure and the faucet model. I had a firm price back within an hour and the faucet was in two days later.
reviews.name: Shauna L.

reviews.text: The triage tool told me the dead outlet was an electrician job, not theirs. They still fixed the rest of my list and gave me the name of the electrician they work with.
reviews.name: Dale W.

reviews.text: We own two rentals in Ypsi. Between tenants they patch, paint, swap blinds and fix screens in one visit, then send a photo list I can forward to the next renter.
reviews.name: Priya K.

reviews.text: The caulk around our tub was black no matter how much we scrubbed. They cut it all out, let the joint dry overnight with a fan, and came back the next morning to lay a clean bead.
reviews.name: Owen H.

reviews.text: He mounted a TV on a plaster wall in our 1920s house. He found the studs, explained why he used toggles in one spot, and the cables run inside the wall now.
reviews.name: Grace F.

proof.guarantee: If something we fixed comes loose or leaks within a year, we come back and redo it at no charge.
